PhotoCraft source used for JavaScript ports
Copyright (c) 2026 ArtCraft Team and the PhotoCraft contributors
Distributed under the MIT license in photocraft.LICENSE-MIT.

Source repository: https://github.com/storytold/photocraft
Source commit: 56dbc89a38248f6e50db50d132de47be88494cf6

Ported or adapted routines:
- crates/algo/src/segment/subject.rs and slic.rs: subject saliency and superpixels
- crates/algo/src/segment/grabcut.rs: object selection and iterative foreground models
- crates/algo/src/segment/mod.rs: graph energy, boundary recuts and antialiasing
- crates/algo/src/segment/quick.rs: brush-seeded, coarse-to-fine selection
- crates/algo/src/segment/focus.rs: local sharpness and focus-area selection
- crates/algo/src/segment/sky.rs: classical sky selection and edge refinement
- crates/algo/src/segment/gmm.rs and segment/mod.rs: color models and component cleanup
- crates/io/src/channel_map.rs and psd_export.rs: alpha display records and Quick Mask resource
- crates/psd/src/path.rs and io/psd_export.rs: saved/work path records and resource writing
- crates/geom/src/warp.rs: fifteen warp preset grids and bicubic evaluation
- crates/geom/src/warp.rs BezierMesh: cubic Bernstein patch evaluation in psd-smart.js meshPoint. warp-place.js rasterizes that mapping with a bounded triangle grid and bilinear samples; this is not the source bicubic rasterizer, and output parity is unverified.
- crates/io/src/blocks.rs placed_frame and parse_placed_warp: a 16-point custom frame uses the control-point bounds; a multi-patch quilt uses the source rectangle. A quilt is rendered only when the point count and slice knots validate. PhotoCraft itself does not import other quilt meshes.
- crates/io/src/smart_map.rs: known smart-filter names and parameters. Replayable items map onto existing editor filters. A stack with any non-replayable filter keeps the stored preview and writes the parsed list back.
- crates/vector/src/lib.rs vector_mask_values and crates/compose/src/masks.rs: vector density is `1 - density * (1 - value)` before feather, then multiplied by the pixel mask. vector-mask.js rasterizes the path with canvas fill antialiasing, not the analytical rasterizer.
- crates/text/src/warp.rs: path-text placement reference
- crates/engine/src/selection_cmds.rs: Color Range selection scoping and tonal fuzziness
- crates/algo/src/selection.rs: span-based Magic Wand and alpha anti-aliasing
- crates/algo/src/selection.rs and color/convert.rs: Color Range and sRGB-to-Lab D50 conversion
- crates/algo/src/selection.rs and selection/distance.rs: Euclidean selection modifications
- crates/algo/src/selection_blur.rs: Gaussian feather kernel and sliding cosine sums
- crates/algo/src/matting.rs: clipped-window means and guided filtering
- crates/algo/src/matting/morphology.rs: octagonal selection morphology


- crates/algo/src/blur.rs and blur2.rs: radial, surface, smart, and depth-aware lens blur sampling
- crates/algo/src/sharpen.rs: fixed sharpen presets and Gaussian unsharp reference
- crates/algo/src/pixelate.rs and fxutil.rs: halftone, crystallize, pointillize, and mezzotint
- crates/algo/src/stylize2.rs: diffuse, contour tracing, and wind
- crates/algo/src/render.rs: fibers and lens flare
- crates/algo/src/distort2.rs and distort.rs: Shear curve interpolation and ZigZag inverse mapping
- crates/algo/src/lens.rs and engine/src/lens_cmds.rs: manual/generic lens correction and bicubic sampling
- crates/algo/src/oil.rs and fxutil.rs: flow-guided oil paint and bristle relief
- crates/engine/src/edit_cmds.rs: clipboard document creation, placement, and grayscale mask paste semantics
- crates/algo/src/video.rs: de-interlace and NTSC chroma limits
- crates/engine/src/filters_ext.rs: filter defaults, ranges, and option records

JavaScript integration and rasterization use the local Canvas editor.
Matching output has not been established by runtime or pixel comparison.

Shape Blur: shape-blur.js derives its nine kernel predicates and span convolution from crates/algo/src/blur2.rs and crates/algo/src/shape_blur.rs in the PhotoCraft source identified above.

Gaussian level smoothing: gaussian-levels.js derives gauss_box_radii / gauss_blur_n from crates/algo/src/fxutil.rs.

Blur Gallery: blur-gallery.js derives variable_blur, field, iris and tilt_shift from crates/algo/src/gallery.rs.

Path/Spin Blur: motion-gallery.js derives path and spin from crates/algo/src/gallery.rs. Extrude: extrude.js derives cell averaging, swept block rasterization and pyramid shading from crates/algo/src/stylize2.rs and crates/algo/src/stylize2/extrude.rs.

Layer clipboard behavior: layer-clipboard.js follows whole_layer / whole_layers selection semantics from crates/engine/src/edit_cmds.rs; storage and canvas integration are local JavaScript implementations.

Image Size: resample.js derives phase rounding, Keys/Lanczos weights, staged downsampling and pass planning from crates/algo/src/resample.rs. Canvas Size background/relative behavior and layer effect scaling follow crates/engine/src/image_cmds.rs and crates/doc/src/lib.rs background traits.

Procedural renderer primitives, SplitMix64 RNG, and Picture Frame: render-primitives.js and picture-frame.js derive from crates/algo/src/render2.rs. Layer compositing and dialogs use the local Canvas engine.

Flame: flame.js derives color ramps, turbulence, placement and strand generation from crates/algo/src/render2.rs. render-polylines.js implements local adaptive cubic flattening and arc-length lookup.

Tree: tree-renderer.js and tree-kinds.js derive the 34 base parameter sets, limb recursion, leaf generation, four growth architectures and lighting from crates/algo/src/render2.rs.

Vanishing Point: vanishing-geometry.js and vanishing-pixels.js derive plane validation, camera lifting, metric frames, tear-off planes, paste and clone strokes from crates/algo/src/vanishing.rs and crates/engine/src/vp_cmds.rs. Bicubic weights derive from crates/algo/src/transform.rs; current strong-reduction warp prefiltering is not ported.

Adaptive Wide Angle: wide-angle-mesh.js derives camera/arc and mesh equations from crates/algo/src/wideangle.rs. sparse-ls.js derives CGLS from crates/algo/src/photo_util.rs. warp-triangles.js derives barycentric rasterization and subsampling from crates/algo/src/warp.rs, with Keys weights from transform.rs. wide-angle-controls.js is local UI integration.

Filter Gallery: gallery-catalog.js derives the 47-filter parameter registry from crates/algo/src/artistic.rs. gallery-utils.js, gallery-artistic.js, gallery-brush.js, gallery-sketch.js, gallery-texture.js and filter-gallery.js derive pixel algorithms and reach rules from crates/algo/src/artistic_fx.rs. gallery-controls.js is local UI integration.

Extended Levels: levels.js derives levels_q / levels_gamma and channel-before-master order from crates/compose/src/adjust.rs. PSD channel field mapping follows the bundled ag-psd levels handler.

RGB ICC conversion: icc-rgb.js follows curve/tag parsing and evaluation from crates/cms/src/profile.rs and curve.rs, and the XYZ D50-to-sRGB matrix and encoding from crates/color/src/convert.rs. Current conversion covers matrix/TRC RGB profiles only.

PSD control-point Curves: curve-points.js derives natural cubic spline solving and channel-before-master composition from crates/compose/src/adjust.rs. Native PSD point field mapping follows the bundled ag-psd curves handler.

Exposure, Threshold, Posterize and brightness-contrast.js derive RGB 8-bit calculations, gamma-2.2 exposure, luminosity split, input bins, modern curves and legacy pivots from crates/compose/src/adjust.rs. psd-smart.js composes existing local affine/perspective/resize operations for PSD placement.

Pass-through group backdrop and premultiplied coverage mixing derive from crates/compose/src/lib.rs composite_layer_plain; clipped pass-through delta composition remains unported.

Raster mask density and mask-feather.js derive density coverage, BoxPass variance/end weights and clamped three-pass separable blur from crates/compose/src/masks.rs.

Smart-filter mask mix/unmix: smart-filter-mask.js follows crates/compose/src/filter_mask.rs. Native FEid RGB/slot-25 alpha generation follows crates/io/src/smart_map.rs feid_item; placement-first filtering and union-bound filter blending follow crates/engine/src/smart_cmds.rs. The bundled FEid writer is locally corrected for per-item extra masks, absent-mask flags and section padding (the enclosing block includes final padding). Adjustment RGB blending, fill-opacity interpolation, and masked pass-through clip deltas follow crates/compose/src/lib.rs composite_layer_plain and advanced.rs.

Smart-filter replay targets follow the pure placed-surface processing of engine/smart_cmds.rs apply_smart_filter; UI target isolation and failure restoration are local document-engine integration.

Native linear-contour Satin mapping follows io/src/effects_map.rs parse_one/write_one/contour_value and the existing compose/effects.rs satin_map port. Shared custom effect mixing uses the existing color/blend.rs-derived compositor.

Vibrance and tonal Color Balance: vibrance.js and color-balance.js follow compose/src/adjust.rs vibrance_px, vibrance_lin, vibrance_skin, color_balance_channel and balance_gamma; controls/PSD fields follow engine/adjust_params.rs and io/adjust_map.rs. photo-filter-color.js and the bundled phfl v3 reader follow io/adjust_map.rs parse_photo_filter's D50-relative XYZ scale; Lab conversion uses the existing color/convert.rs port. Photo Filter density maps native normalized values to local percentages.

Hue/Saturation: hue-saturation.js follows doc/src/adjust.rs HueRange and compose/src/adjust.rs hue_saturation, hue_range_tables, range_lightness and HSL conversion. Native packed hue2 fields follow io/src/adjust_map.rs; hue-saturation-controls.js is local UI integration. Color Lookup: color-lookup.js and lut-files.js follow cms/src/lutfile.rs Cube/3DL/LOOK parsers, Cube writer and eight CC0 built-in look equations, plus compose/src/adjust.rs lut3d_sample and Bayer dithering. Native clrL mapping follows io/src/adjust_map.rs. color-lookup-controls.js is local UI integration.

Vanishing Point new-layer clone copy-back follows engine/src/vp_cmds.rs: compose the visible base with pasted/current pixels, snapshot it, run the metric stroke and copy only changed samples to the target surface.

Grouped clipping base ordering and isolated clipping knockout floors follow compose/src/lib.rs composite_layer_plain and compose/src/advanced.rs composite_clipped. Canonical PNG clipboard identity is local Electron integration.

Group/adjustment/pass-through knockout draw wrappers and individual clipping dispatch follow compose/src/lib.rs composite_layer and compose/src/advanced.rs knockout_shape, knockout and composite_clipped_individually.

FEid mask raw/RLE and sample-depth handling follows psd/src/filter_effects.rs and io/src/pixels.rs. Frozen placement translation follows engine/src/smart_cmds.rs shift_smart; clipboard and canvas frame updates are local integration.

FEid ZIP/ZIP-prediction reversal follows psd/src/compression.rs unpredict for byte, u16 sample and float byte-plane layouts, using the already bundled pako inflater with expected-size-bounded output.

Native Smart Filter pixel units follow io/src/smart_map.rs item_for_filter (#Pxl fields), mapped to ag-psd descriptor unitsValue records.

2026-10-20 Magic Eraser: source eraser_cmds.rs / algo/erase.rs connected to existing worker wand coverage. Independent Contiguous, Anti-alias, Sample All Layers (default false) options; tolerance and opacity. Multiplies region, opacity and selection coverage; alpha lock paints toward background RGB while retaining alpha. Prepares a replacement canvas before a single Undo checkpoint; cancellation, stale-document/layer/revision guards and no-change handling. Currently raster image layers only, local RGBA8 working data; native high-bit/color-space parity and actual pixel/gesture execution remain unverified.

Selection hiding leaves the active crop outline visible. Target Path controls both legacy and direct/whole-path overlays; Count controls all visible count groups. Full Extras and unsupported Show categories remain unconnected. Static and isolated chrome verification only.

View/Show checkbox, scroll refresh, one physical-screen-pixel line width. Rulers/Grid/Guides/Target Path keyboard commands connected. Actual bitmap grid rendering and native high-bit comparison remain unverified; only source/static and isolated chrome checks.

Preferences section order and dialog layout adapted from PhotoCraft crates/engine/src/prefs.rs and crates/ui-egui/src/prefs_ui.rs, commit 56dbc89a38248f6e50db50d132de47be88494cf6. Copyright (c) 2026 ArtCraft Team and contributors. MIT. Supported fields are a subset; unavailable sections are explicitly indicated.

Color panel chip/field/vertical hue/readout geometry and achromatic hue retention follow PhotoCraft crates/ui-egui/src/panels.rs color_field, field_hsva and color_readout, commit 56dbc89a38248f6e50db50d132de47be88494cf6. Copyright (c) 2026 ArtCraft Team and contributors. MIT. DOM implementation retains existing tool color inputs.

Toolbar foreground/background chip metrics and default/swap control placement follow panels.rs color_chips/chip_metrics; Preferences Reset Section and empty search presentation follow prefs_ui.rs. Same PhotoCraft commit and MIT attribution above.

Additional Preferences fields (General/Interface/Workspace/Tools/Performance/Units/Guides/Export/Type/File Handling) follow PhotoCraft prefs.rs and prefs_ui.rs concepts at the commit above. History/recovery limits and Electron persistence are JavaScript host implementations with explicitly different defaults and capabilities. Navigator controls layout follows panels.rs Navigator row; actual zoom stepping retains the JavaScript editor limits.

Fourteen theme color token sets and inherited overrides copied from PhotoCraft crates/ui-egui/src/theme.rs, same commit, Copyright (c) 2026 ArtCraft Team and contributors, MIT. User requires a common Pro UI for every palette; original theme-specific layout variants are not applied. Cursor modes and Grid/Guide/Slice preferences follow prefs.rs/canvas.rs concepts; JS brush contour uses the current JS brush falloff, not the Rust tip profile.

Language registry and translation catalogs adapted from PhotoCraft crates/ui-egui/src/i18n at the same commit. Translation license copied to locales/LICENSE-translations.txt. Catalogs preserve original translations; absent strings fall back to English. Preferences field layout follows prefs_ui.rs declaration-order two-column rows, with Interface Appearance/Presentation/Options groups.

Tooltip preference conjunction follows PhotoCraft prefs_ui.rs sync_tooltips: Interface and Tools switches both required. JavaScript title suppression/restoration and localized-title retention are the local DOM adaptation. Same MIT attribution and source commit above.

General Image Interpolation choices/default copied from PhotoCraft prefs.rs Interpolation. Image Size defaults map nearestNeighbor to the existing JS nearest resampler. Transform interpolation remains pending. Same MIT attribution/commit above.

Interface Clip Thumbnails to Layer Bounds follows PhotoCraft prefs.rs/layer thumbnail framing semantics. Pure rectangle placement supports current JS layer canvases; native representative group/adjustment thumbnails remain separate work. Same MIT attribution/commit above.

Workspace Remember Workspace Changes follows PhotoCraft dock.rs persist/restore gating. Local Electron workspace.json persistence is a JS implementation using the existing atomic settings store. Named workspace saves remain explicit. Ruler preference separation and shutdown flushing remain pending.

View Rulers persistence is independent of Remember Workspace Changes, following PhotoCraft prefs_ui.rs UnitsAndRulers.showRulers semantics. Local schema uses an independent workspace.json key; normal editor return/save waits for pending workspace writes. Forced process termination remains outside that guarantee.

Enhanced Controls Zoom with Trackpad Pinch follows PhotoCraft prefs.rs and canvas.rs setting semantics. Chromium wheel/key adapter is local and has different event-classification limits from native wheel_nav.rs. Same MIT attribution and source commit above.

Navigator wheel/pinch preference routing follows PhotoCraft panels.rs navigator(): ordinary preview wheel zoom is independent of canvas wheel preference, pinch follows Enhanced Controls. JS zoom limits retained; equal-limit updates are skipped. Same attribution above.

Smart Quotes conversion copied from PhotoCraft ui-egui/src/type_tool.rs smart_quotes/opens_quote. Typed-only DOM beforeinput adapter preserves paste and composition paths; native insertText support is required for conversion. Same MIT attribution/source commit above.

General Export Clipboard follows PhotoCraft lib.rs export_os_clipboard gating. Local JS adapter skips OS mirroring/encoding when disabled while preserving existing internal copy state creation. Same MIT attribution/source commit above.

General Always Create Smart Objects When Placing follows PhotoCraft file_cmds.rs embedded/linked policy. Current shared JS embedded placement honors the toggle; fit sizing and new linked-place workflow remain pending. Same attribution above.

Resize Image During Place fit/center/Bicubic policy follows PhotoCraft file_cmds.rs. JS staging reuses resizeSmartPixels and retains original source plus resizePixels replay for smart placement. Real bitmap/replay parity remains unverified. Same attribution above.

UI Scale choices and absolute/native division follow PhotoCraft prefs.rs UiScale and prefs_ui.rs display_scale/sync_display_scale. Chromium implementation uses devicePixelRatio at fixed editor page zoom 1; real display migration remains unverified. Legacy 110% maps to source100%. Same attribution above.

from PhotoCraft (ArtCraft Team and contributors, MIT). Latin sample AaBbCc, 14/18/24/32/40.
